groups.title: Regenerable firmware compiler intermediates
groups.reason: Compiler intermediates/debug output and previous app bundle checks. Can be regenerated and are not read by the desktop/mobile runtime. Original sketches and precompiled flash/rollback images are retained.
groups.evidence: Desktop runtime entry points src/main.js and backend/app.py; sketches retained. Arduino instructions in AGENTS.md.

groups.title: Isolated browser test profiles
groups.reason: Disposable Electron user profiles created by renderer tests, not the real desktop user profile. Tests recreate them; close any test window first.
groups.evidence: Renderer test scripts explicitly set app userData to these scratch paths.

groups.title: Python bytecode caches
groups.reason: Python-generated bytecode. Recreated on import; source .py files remain.
groups.evidence: backend/app.py and scripts sources are retained; .gitignore excludes __pycache__.

groups.title: Five older Android APKs
groups.reason: Superseded installers. Deleting local copies does not uninstall an app or cancel its Expo build. Keep newest Home/registration APK and the immediately previous UI-cleanup APK as fallback.
groups.evidence: Newest build 60237599-4f05-4c1f-8bad-a30fdf2b9860 finished and passed APK checks; physical BLE test pending.

groups.title: Expo exports, copied upload archives and UI fixtures
groups.reason: Generated Android/web bundles, asset copies, local build-inspection copies and fixture HTML. Not read by mobile runtime. Completed cloud builds and retained APKs remain available.
groups.evidence: .easignore excludes artifacts; source/config hashes verified in mobile-home-archive-verification.json. Individual query-bearing files, if present, are excluded.

groups.title: Compiler intermediates and earlier web/Android exports
groups.reason: Compiler intermediates/debug output and previous app bundle checks. Can be regenerated and are not read by the desktop/mobile runtime. Original sketches and precompiled flash/rollback images are retained.

groups.title: Local Expo cache
groups.reason: Local development state and bundler-generated cache. Expo recreates it; developer preferences or remembered devices may reset. Close Expo development server first.

groups.title: Unreferenced starter components and old Explore icons
groups.reason: No imports or configured uses found in current src, scripts, app.json, package.json or tsconfig. Small optional source cleanup; typecheck/export should pass after removal.
groups.evidence: Reference search for ExternalLink, HintRow and Collapsible matched only their own definitions. AppTabs uses Home icon; Explore route is a retained redirect.

groups.title: Standalone data-viewer tool
groups.reason: Not part of Expo navigation or bundled app. Still a working standalone Supabase viewer, so remove only if you no longer use that browser tool.
groups.evidence: No src or package references; .easignore excludes data-viewer. Its index.html loads its own scripts.

groups.title: Separate AC-energy training artifacts
groups.reason: Current Flask runtime selects three original models in backend/ml, not this training-output folder. These are distinct trained artifacts, not duplicates; retraining/experiment history may still matter.
groups.evidence: backend/app.py:98-101 enumerates original model files. No current runtime references to models/ac_energy found. Keep backend/ml and preprocessing script.

groups.title: Unreferenced copied LevelDB folder
groups.reason: No runtime or script references found, but contents are persistent browser storage. Origin is not proven; review or back up before any removal.
groups.evidence: No temp_leveldb references in src, public, backend, scripts, README or package. .ldb is data rather than disposable log text.

groups.title: Historical reports, source backups and one-time patch/audit helpers
groups.reason: Not required by app startup, but preserve debugging evidence and earlier uncommitted source. Some helpers query or modify real data. Archive selectively; keep SQL-containing files, active generator inputs, latest report and firmware.
groups.evidence: Historical folders, file types and no runtime scratch/report references. Current mobile has extensive uncommitted/untracked changes, so Git alone is not a backup.

groups.title: Unreferenced duplicate image copies
groups.reason: No current references found to these specific paths/names. Root login image matches the used public/assets image byte-for-byte; transparent images match each other. Optional cleanup because original editable/design assets may still be wanted.
groups.evidence: Both regular ecoTrack.png copies are retained: src/main.js uses assets/ecoTrack.png and login.html uses public/assets/ecoTrack.png. public/assets/login-bg.jpg is retained.

groups.title: Original SVG icon sources
groups.reason: No asset-path imports found. The app uses embedded SVG constants. These are original editable asset files, so archive or retain if future icon editing matters.
groups.evidence: Reference search in current src, scripts and Expo configuration found no assets/icons path uses; src/constants/custom-icons.ts supplies inline SVG data.

groups.title: Expo starter reset script
groups.reason: Starter utility resets or moves application source to a blank template, which is not needed for normal EcoTrack operation. Cannot be deleted alone while its package.json command remains.
groups.evidence: package.json has reset-project pointing to this file. Optional paired proposal: remove that command as well, only with explicit approval.

groups.title: Previous APK fallback
groups.reason: Keep for now. Could be retired after the latest APK passes real-phone Bluetooth and remote state testing. Removing it now removes the immediate local rollback installer.
groups.evidence: New Home/registration APK is verified but physical Bluetooth testing remains pending.

groups.title: Firmware flash/rollback images and related metadata
groups.reason: Keep by default: precompiled images may be useful for restoring hardware. Current toolchain might not reproduce the exact older binary. Separate approval is needed to retire them.
groups.evidence: Flashable .bin files and flash_args/partition/build metadata were observed in generated firmware folders. They do not run the desktop/mobile app but may be used to flash the ESP32.
